record.interface_detail: REST API at https://api.v0.dev with the v0 npm SDK (v0 in v2, v0-sdk in v1), authenticated by an API key made in the v0 settings; a remote MCP server at https://v0.app/api/mcp that signs in by OAuth, and AI SDK tools (@v0-sdk/ai-tools). Chats are created and continued by calls such as chats.create and messages.send, with async variants, so a generation can run with no browser. The docs list no command-line client (the /docs/cli page does not exist). Whether a Free account may mint an API key was not seen: the keys page answered a login wall
record.tooling: the user calls the v0 REST API or installs the npm package v0 (or the v1 package v0-sdk) in a program they run, or adds https://v0.app/api/mcp as a remote MCP server to an MCP-capable client; the apps v0 builds deploy to Vercel
record.chaining: the Free plan builds the app and deploys it to a Vercel account, whose Hobby plan hosts it (see compute/vercel and egress/vercel-hobby); the daily message count is the only generation budget on Free

limits.value: 7 messages a day on Free; the API reports the remaining count and the reset time in the dailyLimit object of GET /v1/rate-limits
